name: evaluation_id
description: Unique id for this evaluation; primary key of the registry.

name: recorded_at
description: event time; partition key

name: evaluated_at
description: evaluation start

name: finished_at
description: Evaluation completion time; NULL while status is RUNNING.

name: event
description: RUNNING | FINAL

name: status
description: RUNNING | SUCCEEDED | SUCCEEDED_WITH_WARNINGS | PARTIAL | SKIPPED | FAILED

name: status_reason
description: Human-readable reason for a non-SUCCEEDED status.

name: evaluation_key
description: deterministic idempotency key

name: trigger
description: cli | composer | chained | agent

name: runner
description: Beam runner the evaluation ran on (e.g. DirectRunner, DataflowRunner).

name: mode
description: exact | sampled

name: evaluator_version
description: sdfb-evaluation package version that produced this row (EVALUATOR_VERSION).

name: catalogue_version
description: Metric catalogue version applied by this evaluation.

name: evaluation_job_id
description: Job id of the evaluation run itself, on a runner that assigns one.

name: image
description: Container image URI the evaluation ran in.

name: generation_job_id
description: Dataflow job id of the generation run being evaluated.

name: generation_job_name
description: Dataflow job name of the generation run being evaluated.

name: generation_region
description: Region the generation Dataflow job ran in.

name: generation_started_at
description: Start time of the generation job being evaluated.

name: generation_finished_at
description: Finish time of the generation job being evaluated.

name: base_run_id
description: Root run id shared by every table in a relational launch.

name: run_ids
description: Every run_id this evaluation covers, one per table in a relational launch.

name: params_source
description: jobs_labels+logs | logs | dataflow_params | manual

name: relationship_model
description: Name of the relationship model (config/relationships/*.yaml) the generation run applied.

name: relationship_model_sha
description: SHA of the relationship model file the generation run applied.

name: relationship_model_uri
description: gs:// URI of the pinned relationship model.

name: model_adjusted
description: True if the declared relationship model was adjusted from a measured source (ADR 0038).

name: tables
description: Per-table results for this launch, one entry per table in the relationship model.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Table name within the relationship model.

fields.name: landing_table
fields.description: Destination table FQN the synthetic rows were written to.

fields.name: source_table
fields.description: Source table FQN the synthetic rows were generated from.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Generation run id for this table.

fields.name: role
fields.description: root | driven | side_input | isolated | standalone | external

fields.name: scope_mode
fields.description: table | as_of | appends | as_of_diff | manual

fields.name: scope_status
fields.description: ok | count_mismatch | contaminated | expired | empty | unknown

fields.name: scope_ok
fields.description: True if the scope check passed.

fields.name: scope_reason
fields.description: Human-readable reason for a non-ok scope_status.

fields.name: window_start
fields.description: Start of the appends/as_of/as_of_diff scope window.

fields.name: window_end
fields.description: End of the appends/as_of/as_of_diff scope window.

fields.name: source_snapshot_ts
fields.description: FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF pin used to read the source table.

fields.name: source_drifted
fields.description: True if the source table changed after the pinned snapshot was taken.

fields.name: reference_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical reference sample (provenance).

fields.name: reference_verified
fields.description: True if the reference digest matched the pinned source snapshot.

fields.name: reference_n
fields.description: Row count of the reference sample (R).

fields.name: exposure_n
fields.description: Row count of the prompt-exposed rows (E).

fields.name: holdout_n
fields.description: Row count of the holdout set (H).

fields.name: rows_source
fields.description: Row count of the pinned source table at evaluation time.

fields.name: rows_synthetic
fields.description: Row count of the synthetic landing table at evaluation time.

fields.name: rows_expected
fields.description: Row count the generation run was expected to produce for this table.

fields.name: sampled
fields.description: True if this table's metrics were computed on a sample rather than exactly.

fields.name: sample_rate_source
fields.description: Fraction of the source table sampled for evaluation.

fields.name: sample_rate_synthetic
fields.description: Fraction of the synthetic table sampled for evaluation.

fields.name: encoding_plan_digest
fields.description: Digest of the column-encoding plan used for this table's metrics.

fields.name: table_score
fields.description: Aggregate score for this table, rolled up from its metrics.

name: engine
description: b1_rag | b2_library — generation engine used.

name: llm_model_uri
description: gs:// URI of the LLM weights used for generation.

name: embedder_id
description: Embedder id used for B.1 RAG retrieval.

name: seed
description: value | derived

name: similarity
description: Similarity threshold/parameter used for RAG retrieval.

name: retrieval_method
description: RAG retrieval method (e.g. prefix, k-center).

name: reference_rows_limit
description: Cap on reference rows read for generation.

name: num_rows_requested
description: Rows the generation run was asked to produce.

name: uniqueness_mode
description: Uniqueness enforcement mode applied during generation.

name: freetext_expansion
description: Free-text expansion strategy applied during generation.

name: source_stats_tier
description: sample | exact — source-stats tier used (ADR 0022).

name: profiler_version
description: Version of the source profiler used to compute stats.

name: write_disposition
description: BigQuery write disposition used by the generation sink.

name: env
description: dev | uat | prd — threshold tier applied.

name: client_type
description: ModelClient implementation that served the LLM (e.g. vllm).

name: vllm_dtype
description: dtype vLLM was launched with (e.g. float16, bfloat16).

name: generation_params
description: Full generation launch config snapshot; the typed filters above are duplicated flat for the GUI.

name: evaluation_params
description: Full evaluation CLI/config snapshot.

name: overall_score
description: Overall evaluation score, rolled up across fidelity/privacy/integrity/diversity.

name: fidelity_score
description: Fidelity pillar score.

name: privacy_score
description: Privacy pillar score.

name: integrity_score
description: Integrity pillar score.

name: diversity_score
description: Diversity pillar score.

name: metrics_total
description: Measured metric rows across every table (aggregate *_score rows excluded); equals metrics_pass + metrics_warn + metrics_fail + metrics_info + metrics_not_evaluated.

name: metrics_pass
description: Metrics with status = pass.

name: metrics_warn
description: Metrics with status = warn.

name: metrics_fail
description: Metrics with status = fail.

name: metrics_not_evaluated
description: Metrics with status = not_evaluated.

name: metrics_info
description: Metrics with status = info (measured, not gated).

name: bq_bytes_processed
description: Total bytes processed by the BigQuery queries this evaluation issued.

name: predicted_shuffle_gb
description: Predicted Beam shuffle volume in GB for this evaluation job.

name: warnings
description: Non-fatal warnings raised during evaluation.

name: artifacts_uri
description: GCS URI of the HTML/JSON evaluation artifacts for this run.
